description: This file defines a class 'PdfFileCreator' that provides methods for creating and adding pages to a PDF document using the PdfSharp library, as well as a static class 'TestData' containing lorem ipsum text for testing purposes.

classes.name: PdfFileCreator
classes.description: A class that generates PDF files with multiple pages and renders them with styled boxes and sample text.

classes.name: TestData
classes.description: A static class containing sample lorem ipsum text for use within PDF generation.

methods.name: AddPages
methods.description: Adds a specified number of pages to the given PDF document.

methods.name: AddPage
methods.description: Creates a new page in the PDF document and draws a styled rectangle with sample text inside it.

methods.name: RenderSnippet
methods.description: Renders visual boxes with different styles for demonstration purposes.
